title: Practice: the design of a pull request pipeline that uses Claude (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 who waits decides between real time and batch
cases.says: A job a person waits for is real time, a job nobody waits for is a batch

cases.id: e1 a review has a pass for each file and then an integration pass
cases.says: The review has a pass per file, then an integration pass

cases.id: e2 a review runs in a fresh session and is given the earlier findings
cases.says: The review runs in a fresh session and is given the earlier findings

cases.id: e3 every claude command is headless json and bounded
cases.says: Every claude command is headless, JSON and bounded; the schema has a closed severity and required fields

cases.id: e4 the review can only read
cases.says: The review has read tools only, in its list and in its command

cases.id: e5 the criteria name what to report what to skip and an example for each severity
cases.says: The criteria list what to report and skip, give an example for each severity and use no vague phrase

cases.id: e6 the test prompt passes the existing tests and says what a useful test is
cases.says: The test prompt passes the changed files and the existing tests and defines a useful test

cases.id: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No personal path, address or key in any file
